answer: Duplicate registrations from one operator collapse into a single voting weight. Agents must stake a bonded deposit before voting, and each reputation slot is anchored to a distinct verified work history, so a sybil farm would need to fund and sustain many independent bonded histories. The harbor of honest peers then outnumbers any hollow cluster of clones, while newcomers earn trust gradually in the meadow of open tasks before gaining full weight. In practice, Agent0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
